def transform(g):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find full separator lines (rows/cols of a single nonzero color)
    lrows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0 and w>1 or (len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0)]
    lrows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0]
    lcols=[j for j in range(w) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and g[0][j]!=0]
    # background = most common non-line color
    from collections import Counter
    cells=[v for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if i not in lrows and j not in lcols]
    c=Counter(cells); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    odd=set(cells)-{bg}
    assert len(odd)==1, odd
    odd=odd.pop()
    # row bands and col bands
    def bands(l,n):
        b=[];cur=[]
        for i in range(n):
            if i in l:
                if cur: b.append(cur); cur=[]
            else: cur.append(i)
        if cur: b.append(cur)
        return b
    rb=bands(lrows,h); cb=bands(lcols,w)
    out=[[bg]*len(cb) for _ in rb]
    for a,rows in enumerate(rb):
        for b,cols in enumerate(cb):
            n=sum(1 for i in rows for j in cols if g[i][j]==odd)
            if n==2: out[a][b]=1
    return out
